items.q: You see, when he gives you... When he'd tell you to come to his house, he'd give you the wrong address... 'No Mister Roberts stayed here.'

ctx.x: You see, when he gives you... When he'd tell you to come to his house, he'd give you the wrong address. You'd knock on his White neighbor's house over on 164th Street, and she said, "Listen, I'm tired of people coming here. No Mister Roberts stayed here." Because he was keeping three women at all times, in different apartments. A maniac.
He was a little short guy, wide as he was tall almost.
